rationale: The dev-authored spec (workflows-folders.spec.js, merged at HEAD) already covers WFF-UI-01..WFF-UI-13 — every behavior in the reachability table except one. The single uncovered behavior is 'Editor shows static folder on edit' (WorkflowEditor.vue:62-64, v-else span with activeFolderName): the page object exposes expectEditorFolderPickerHidden() but no spec ever calls it. extend WFF-UI-11 with that one assertion rather than writing anything new.

extension.test: WFF-UI-11: the folder survives the trip into the editor and back
extension.why: Asserts the create-only folder picker (data-test='workflow-editor-folder', v-if='!workflowObj.isEditWorkflow') is NOT rendered when editing — the editor shows static folder text instead. This is the one WIRED behavior with no existing assertion.
